## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change does. Link the public issue when available.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Separate deterministic tests from physical-device/UI validation. State what was not run and why.

## Documentation and compatibility

- [ ] User-facing behavior and the changelog are updated where applicable.
- [ ] `doc/devlog.md` is appended, and `doc/current.md` reflects any state change.
- [ ] Relevant macOS, capture, window-ownership, and third-party notice boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Temporary builds are cleaned up; no credentials, personal diagnostics, or build caches are included.
